items.title: 'Feels like we've been scammed': Graduates unhappy with uni degrees
items.description: Australian students are the least satisfied they have ever been with their university degrees, according to a long-running survey, leaving some questioning the value of their qualifications.

items.title: Small plane crashes into Beijing's tallest building
items.description: Two bystanders have said an aircraft about the size of a car has crashed into Beijing's CITIC Tower.

items.title: Andrew 'Twiggy' Forrest warns Fortescue staff after sexual harassment class action
items.description: In an email sent to all staff, Mr Forrest said: "Anyone who thinks this behaviour has a place at Fortescue is in the wrong company."

items.title: Hundreds killed as Venezuela struck by 'doublet' earthquake
items.description: The deadly one-two punch that toppled buildings in Venezuela's capital and beyond was a doublet earthquake, a pair of similar-sized quakes close in location and time.

items.title: Stefanovic's move to outsider politics follows a well-worn lucrative path
items.description: Listening to the culture war showman schtick he has so quickly adopted, Karl Stefanovic is now less a newsman than an ideological performer.

items.title: Ukraine launches one of its heaviest drone attacks on Russia
items.description: Authorities in Russian-annexed Crimea have declared an "emergency situation".

items.title: How China's new 'ethnic unity' law could target people in Australia
items.description: The Australian government raises concerns directly with China over the country's new ethnic unity law, which allows Beijing to target people overseas.

items.title: Broncos coach rejects claim season is done despite seventh straight loss

items.title: Giants 'obliterated' at stoppage as Hawks win at MCG on night of injuries
items.description: Hawks hold on at the MCG to beat GWS and lock up third spot for the moment, in a game marred by a number of big injuries.

items.title: Reaction to Karl Stefanovic leaving Channel Nine

items.title: Former cricketer pleads guilty to underage sexual abuse charges
items.description: Aaron William Summers was playing for the Hobart Hurricanes in January 2018 when the underage sexual abuse occurred, a Tasmanian court has heard.

items.title: Menopause and perimenopause support expands into nationwide clinics
items.description: Access to physiotherapy, dietetics and psychology services will become routine in a national expansion to menopause and perimenopause support from July 1.

items.title: How I save money by storing and cooking things differently
items.description: I've developed simple storage and cooking systems that keep food visible and fresh while ensuring I use things up. Here's how I make cooking for one feel more doable, affordable and lower-impact.

items.title: Police investigate two deaths linked to fatal crash in WA's Midwest
items.description: Detectives are probing the deaths of a woman in a crash and a man who was found dead in a hotel a day later.

items.title: Another suspected H5 bird flu case detected in WA
items.description: Another suspected positive case of the H5 bird flu has been detected in Western Australia, marking the fifth confirmed or suspected case in Australia.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Neil the Seal, the teals party down and Trump drains his swamp

items.title: Why the Moana live action movie has come so soon
items.description: Dwayne Johnson and Sydneysider Catherine Lagaʻaia have walked the blue carpet at a special event in Sydney. They told ABC News why now is the perfect time for a live action Moana.

items.title: Supergirl shoots for the moon, but runs out of fuel
items.description: Australian Milly Alcock shines as Supergirl in the hero's first solo outing since 1984. If only the rest of the movie sparkled around her.

items.title: No-show cuttlefish result in million-dollar loss for regional SA town
items.description: Whyalla has been forced to wind back services and let staff let go as its tourism industry suffers million-dollar losses from cuttlefish not making their usual migration.

items.title: UN pauses Strait of Hormuz evacuation after ship reports attack
items.description: The UN pauses its operation to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz after a vessel reports an attack.

items.title: Comparing Trump's Iran negotiations to what Obama already did
items.description: The Trump administration has been negotiating directly with Iran this week in an effort to reach a long-term peace agreement, but it has several hurdles to clear before it can better the deal the United States already had.

items.title: 'ISIS bride' charged with slavery offences is granted bail
items.description: A court grants bail for Melbourne grandmother Kawsar Ahmad, who is alleged to have owned a slave while in Syria under Islamic State rule.

items.title: Man sentenced for 'execution' of police officer serving repossession notice
items.description: Tasmanian man Leigh Sushames shot dead Keith Smith last year when the police constable tried to serve him with a home repossession notice.
